title: Slow Flowing MRI Phantom for FLAIR Validation
author: Brianna France

steps.title: Calculate Required Volumetric Flow Rate
steps.instruction: Determine the pump setting required to achieve a target CSF velocity of 300 µm/s (0.3 mm/s) within the catheter tubes.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the catheter's cross-sectional area (A) using the priming volume (1600 mm³) and total catheter length (1828.8 mm): A = 1600 mm³ / 1828.8 mm = 0.875 mm².
Compute the volumetric flow rate (Q) using the formula Q = v × A: Q = (0.3 mm/s)(0.875 mm²) = 0.2625 mm³/s.
Convert the flow rate to microliters per second: Q = 0.2625 µL/s.

steps.title: Prepare Contrast Syringe
steps.instruction: Fill a 0.5-1 mL syringe with 0.1 mM contrast solution (typically Gd-based diluted in saline).

substeps.instruction: Remove all bubbles by gentle tapping and slow plunger advancement.
Replace the cap to keep the system closed.
Cut off the plunger.

steps.title: Build Phantom Chamber
steps.instruction: Construct the housing and integrate the contrast syringe.

substeps.instruction: Cut the bottom off a 15 mL conical tube to create a cylindrical housing.
Attach inflow and outflow tubing to the contrast-filled syringe.
Insert the syringe horizontally so it is centered within the tube.
Secure the syringe with tape to ensure it is fully supported and cannot rotate.
Connect catheter tubing to the second catheter extension attached to the syringe (inflow).
Connect a second tube to the opposite end (outflow).
Verify that both lines are straight and free of kinks.

steps.title: Position Phantom in MRI
steps.instruction: Place the assembled phantom into the scanner.

substeps.instruction: Place the 15 mL tube (containing the syringe and flow tubes) into the mouse head coil.
Align the syringe barrel with the coil's isocenter for uniform sensitivity.
Secure the phantom with clay or tape to prevent shifting during scanning.

steps.title: Set Up Syringe Pump
steps.instruction: Configure the pump and fluid lines outside the MRI gauss line.

substeps.instruction: Load a 10 mL syringe filled with water onto the pump.
Connect the inflow catheter tubing to the filled syringe.
Connect the outflow tubing to a 15 mL waste tube.
Position the waste tube through a hole in the lid, safely away from the coil and electronics.
Ensure the waste tube is at or below the phantom height to prevent gravity-induced back-pressure.

steps.title: Prime the System
steps.instruction: Flush the system to remove air and verify leaks, ideally before placing in the scanner.

substeps.instruction: Run the pump at a slow rate (e.g., 0.1–0.3 mL/min) until fluid reaches the waste container.
Flush the system until the flow path is completely air-free.
Confirm that the tubes surrounding the contrast syringe fill smoothly and there are no leaks.

steps.title: Perform MRI Scanning
steps.instruction: Execute the imaging sequences on the phantom.

substeps.instruction: Run a Fast Spin Echo sequence.
Run a FLAIR sequence.
